passages.text: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
passages.sermon:
Hallelujah!
We praise the LORD.
It is good to sing to our God.
Praising Him is pleasant.
Praising Him is beautiful.
passages.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ כִּי־ ט֭וֹב זַמְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ נָ֝עִים נָאוָ֥ה תְהִלָּֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and authority.
The LORD builds up Jerusalem.
The LORD gathers the exiles of Israel.
The LORD brings His people together.
passages.original: בּוֹנֵ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה נִדְחֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל יְכַנֵּֽס׃

passages.text: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD heals people who have broken hearts.
He binds up their wounds.
The LORD cares for those who are hurting.
He gives comfort to those who suffer.

passages.text: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
passages.sermon: God determines the number of the stars.\r\nGod calls each star by its name.
passages.original: מוֹנֶ֣ה מִ֭סְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִ֑ים לְ֝כֻלָּ֗ם שֵׁמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא׃

passages.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is great.
The Lord is mighty in power.
The Lord has unlimited understanding.
No one can measure His wisdom.
passages.original: גָּד֣וֹל אֲדוֹנֵ֣ינוּ וְרַב־ כֹּ֑חַ לִ֝תְבוּנָת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

passages.text: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts with power and wisdom.
The LORD sustains humble people.
The LORD supports those who are lowly.
The LORD brings down wicked people.
The LORD casts the wicked to the ground.
passages.original: מְעוֹדֵ֣ד עֲנָוִ֣ים יְהוָ֑ה מַשְׁפִּ֖יל רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֲדֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God, who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
He deserves our thanks.
Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving.
Play music to our God on the harp.
God covers the sky with clouds.
God prepares rain for the earth.
God makes grass grow on the hills.
passages.original: עֱנ֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה בְּתוֹדָ֑ה זַמְּר֖וּ לֵאלֹהֵ֣ינוּ בְכִנּֽוֹר׃ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֬ה שָׁמַ֨יִם׀ בְּעָבִ֗ים הַמֵּכִ֣ין לָאָ֣רֶץ מָטָ֑ר הַמַּצְמִ֖יחַ הָרִ֣ים חָצִֽיר׃

passages.text: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
passages.sermon: The LORD gives food to the animals.\r\nHe gives food to the young ravens when they call.
passages.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לִבְהֵמָ֣ה לַחְמָ֑הּ לִבְנֵ֥י עֹ֝רֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְרָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legpower of the man.
passages.sermon: God does not delight in the strength of the horse.\r\nGod does not take pleasure in the power of a man's legs.
passages.original: לֹ֤א בִגְבוּרַ֣ת הַסּ֣וּס יֶחְפָּ֑ץ לֹֽא־ בְשׁוֹקֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ יִרְצֶֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
passages.sermon: The LORD is pleased with certain people.\r\nThese people fear Him.\r\nThese people hope in His loving devotion.
passages.original: רוֹצֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ יְרֵאָ֑יו אֶת־ הַֽמְיַחֲלִ֥ים לְחַסְדּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
passages.sermon: Jerusalem, praise the LORD.\r\nZion, praise your God.
passages.original: שַׁבְּחִ֣י יְ֭רוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה הַֽלְלִ֖י אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִיּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is strong.
The LORD gives strength to your gates.
The LORD makes your city secure.
The LORD blesses your children.
Your children live among you.
The LORD gives them His blessing.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ חִ֭זַּק בְּרִיחֵ֣י שְׁעָרָ֑יִךְ בֵּרַ֖ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃

passages.text: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and care.
God makes your borders peaceful.
God fills you with the best wheat.
God provides safety.
God gives you abundant food.
passages.original: הַשָּׂם־ גְּבוּלֵ֥ךְ שָׁל֑וֹם חֵ֥לֶב חִ֝טִּ֗ים יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power and authority.
God sends His command to the earth.
God’s word moves quickly everywhere.
God’s word accomplishes His will without delay.
passages.original: הַשֹּׁלֵ֣חַ אִמְרָת֣וֹ אָ֑רֶץ עַד־ מְ֝הֵרָ֗ה יָר֥וּץ דְּבָרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes; He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
passages.sermon:
God controls the weather.
God spreads the snow like wool.
God scatters the frost like ashes.
God throws His hail like pebbles.
No one can stand before His icy blast.
passages.original: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן שֶׁ֣לֶג כַּצָּ֑מֶר כְּ֝פ֗וֹר כָּאֵ֥פֶר יְפַזֵּֽר׃ מַשְׁלִ֣יךְ קַֽרְח֣וֹ כְפִתִּ֑ים לִפְנֵ֥י קָ֝רָת֗וֹ מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃

passages.text: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
passages.sermon:
God acts with power over creation.
God sends out His word.
His word melts the ice and snow.
God sends His wind.
The waters begin to flow.
passages.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּבָר֣וֹ וְיַמְסֵ֑ם יַשֵּׁ֥ב ר֝וּח֗וֹ יִזְּלוּ־ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jacob.
God gives His word to Jacob.
God gives His laws to Israel.
God gives His judgments to Israel.
passages.original: מַגִּ֣יד דְּבָרוֹ לְיַעֲקֹ֑ב חֻקָּ֥יו וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטָ֗יו לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
God gave His word, statutes, and judgments to Israel.
\r\nGod did not do this for any other nation.
\r\nOther nations do not know God's judgments.
\r\nPraise the Lord!
passages.original: לֹ֘א עָ֤שָׂה כֵ֨ן׀ לְכָל־ גּ֗וֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֥ים בַּל־ יְדָע֗וּם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
